battle.name: 倫岑之戰
battle.brief: 九二九年九月四日，薩克森精選民兵在倫岑堡外與維萊提聯盟的雷達利人及里諾人步兵方陣爆發整日血戰。假退不成，泥濘妨礙騎兵機動，直至梅爾澤堡伯爵提特馬爾的騎兵迂迴側翼，方陣才被衝垮，翌晨守軍開城投降。卡面的斯巴達長矛並未現身此役，但其套柄長矛的形制，正是雙方步兵所執長矛的直系祖型。

kit.name: 斯巴達長矛
kit.history: 兩米長的木槍，槍尾帶銅套。方陣裡它比劍更早決定誰站得住。

countries: 這場戰爭發生在德意志王國東法蘭克時期的北方邊疆。一方是薩克森公國及其精選民兵，隸屬國王亨利一世（人稱捕鳥者亨利的國王，他以鷹獵維持軍費的傳說流傳甚廣），由薩克森貴族貝恩哈德伯爵統率；貝恩哈德同時負責與雷達利人維持既有的納貢關係，騎兵則交由梅爾澤堡伯爵提特馬爾指揮，軍中另有各伯爵與諸侯自帶的軍事家戶，配備受訓的騎兵與步卒。另一方是維萊提聯盟北部的雷達利人與里諾人：雷達利人是德意志人的附庸部族，里諾人則以倫岑這座壘寨為據，雙方領袖的姓名皆不傳於史冊。背景還牽涉波希米亞公國與匈牙利部族的馬扎爾人——九二四年馬扎爾人曾借道波希米亞襲擊圖林根與薩克森，薩克森軍方隨即在易北河與薩勒河之間修築堡壘防線，取代過去單靠野戰攔截的作戰方式。整個體系的重心，是一條由薩勒河延伸至易北河、堡壘與藩鎮相間的東境防線，而倫岑正是這條線上最靠近薩克森本土的一枚釘子。
countriesEn: The battle was fought on the northern frontier of the East Frankish kingdom, in the lands east of the Elbe. On one side stood the Duchy of Saxony and its Saxon select levy, subjects of the German king Henry I, Henry the Fowler, the king whose legend told of supporting the army out of his hawking, and the field command was given to the Saxon magnate Count Bernhard, who was also the man responsible for keeping up the existing tribute relations with the Redarii; the cavalry of the host was led by Thietmar, Count of Merseburg, and the army was enlarged by the military households of the other counts and nobles, each bringing its own trained riders and footmen. On the other side stood the Redarii and the Linones, peoples of the northern part of the Veleti confederation: the Redarii were a tributary of the Germans, while the Linones held Lenzen, the fortified settlement in question, and the names of the leaders on that side are preserved nowhere. The wider setting also involved the Duchy of Bohemia and the Magyar horsemen of the Principality of Hungary, who in 924 rode through Bohemian territory to raid Thuringia and Saxony, whereupon the Saxons began to build a line of fortresses between the Saale and the Elbe in place of the older habit of intercepting raiders in the open field. The heart of the whole system was a frontier running from the Saale to the Elbe in which fortresses and garrisons alternated, and Lenzen was the nail of that line lying closest to the Saxon homeland itself.
people: 關鍵人物可分四層。第一是國王亨利一世：本人未親臨倫岑陣前，但下令組軍、選定進攻目標與時機，是這場戰爭的實際策劃者；此前一年他已攻下勃蘭登堡與加納，並在薩勒河與易北河之間建立堡壘連線。第二是薩克森貴族貝恩哈德：奉命集結薩克森部隊、統率全軍，戰前以騎兵巡哨偵察，戰中以假退引誘雷達利人出陣，是全役的現場指揮者。第三是梅爾澤堡伯爵提特馬爾：他任騎兵指揮，率騎兵在關鍵時刻迂迴敵陣兩翼，最終扭轉敗局；同族的編年史家梅爾澤堡的提特馬爾留下《編年史》一書，是本役最重要的文字記錄，其中記下家族有兩位名叫洛塔爾的曾祖父——瓦爾貝克伯爵與施塔德伯爵——皆陣亡於此役。第四是雷達利人與里諾人：史料未留下他們指揮官的姓名，只留下兩族的名號與倫岑守軍的存在；守軍在野戰部隊覆滅後仍據堡一日，才於翌晨開城。整場戰爭的勝負，其實由一位不曾現身的國王、一位在泥濘中計算騎兵時機的伯爵，以及一位把家族榮譽寫進編年史的人共同決定。
peopleEn: Four sets of men matter in this story. First, the king, Henry I, who was not present at Lenzen himself but who ordered the host assembled and chose both the target and the moment for the attack; in the year before he had already stormed Brandenburg and the stronghold of Gana and had begun the chain of fortresses between the Saale and the Elbe. Second, the Saxon magnate Bernhard, who was given the task of raising the Saxon forces and commanded them in the field, sending out mounted patrols to reconnoitre and trying to draw the Redarii out of their lines with a feigned retreat; he was the on-the-spot commander of the whole action. Third, Thietmar, Count of Merseburg, who led the cavalry, carried it round the flanks of the enemy at the decisive moment and turned the battle; the chronicler Thietmar of Merseburg, of the same family, left behind the Chronicon, the most important written record of the fight, and in it he records that two great-grandfathers of his family, both named Lothar, the Count of Walbeck and the Count of Stade, were killed here. Fourth, the Redarii and the Linones: the sources preserve no name for their commander, only the names of the two peoples and the existence of the garrison at Lenzen, which held the stronghold for a further day after the field army had been destroyed and opened its gates only the following morning. The outcome was in truth settled by a king who never showed up, a count who read the moment for the cavalry out of the mud, and a man who wrote his family's honour into a chronicle.
kits: 卡面上的斯巴達長矛——兩米長的木槍、槍尾帶銅套——並沒有出現在九二九年的倫岑原野：這種希臘長矛在地中海世界早於羅馬時期便已退出軍備，十世紀的歐洲北方步兵也不會使用希臘式銅套木槍。但它確實是本役雙方所執長矛的設計母型。斯巴達長矛的關鍵在「套」：槍頭以中空銅套咬合木桿，使折損的槍桿可以單獨更換；這種套柄構思，正是北歐青銅器時代的套柄矛頭一路傳承到鐵器時代的北方長矛，再落進薩克森民兵與雷達利人手中的那條線。卡面所說「方陣裡它比劍更早決定誰站得住」，說的正是一列無甲無盾的矛兵在方陣中能撐住的最長攻擊距離的物理保證。本役薩克森一方的主要裝備是：精選民兵執套柄鐵矛頭長矛與圓盾，配短刀；各伯爵與諸侯軍事家戶的騎兵用長矛、劍與弓箭，具備較完整的鎖子甲與鼻護盔，馬匹為本地繁育的重型騎乘馬，專責追擊與迂迴。雷達利人與里諾人的記載更簡：他們有長矛、小圓盾與斧，卻完全沒有騎兵編制——正是這一點使他們在兩翼無法應對襲擊。攻城方面，薩克森軍依古羅馬兵家韋格蒂烏斯的成法先建野營，設哨與巡騎屏護，備帳篷與糧食準備長期圍城；倫岑壘寨為木柵與土築工事構成的斯拉夫堡寨，史料未載此役使用攻城砲。
kitsEn: The dory on the card, a two-metre wooden spear with a copper socket at the butt, did not stand on the field at Lenzen in 929: this Greek spear had left Mediterranean service long before the Roman period, and no infantryman in northern Europe in the tenth century carried a Greek socketed wooden shaft. It is, however, the design ancestor of the spears actually used on both sides that day. The point of the dory lies in its socket: the socketed head grips the wooden shaft so that a broken haft can be replaced on its own, and that socketed principle runs in an unbroken line from the socketed spearheads of the Nordic Bronze Age to the iron socketed spears of northern warriors, and from there into the hands of Saxon levies and Redarii alike. The card's own line, that in a phalanx it decided who would still be standing before the sword could, states exactly the physical guarantee that a line of naked spears gave to a phalanx which held its order. The Saxons fielded the select levy with socketed iron-tipped spears and round shields, and a short seax at the hip; the cavalry of the counts and nobles rode with lance, sword and bow, wearing mail and nasal helms of their own, on locally bred heavy riding horses meant for pursuit and shock. The Redarii and the Linones are recorded far more briefly: they had spears, small round shields and axes, and no cavalry formation at all, and that was precisely why they could not answer a threat against their flanks. For the blockade the Saxons followed the practice of the Roman soldier-writer Vegetius, building a fortified camp first, with pickets and a mounted screen, and bringing tents and provisions for a long siege; Lenzen was a Slavic gord of timber palisade and earthwork, and the sources name no siege engine used against it.
tactics: 作戰全程可分四段。八月三十日，薩克森軍抵達倫岑，隨即依古羅馬兵法築起設防野營，派出哨兵與騎兵偵察線；守軍據堡不出，薩克森軍則備妥帳篷與糧食，準備長期圍城。九月三日，貝恩哈德的巡騎發現大批雷達利人正在策劃夜襲營地，軍中隨即加強戒備，等來的不是夜襲，而是翌日的會戰。九月四日，雷達利人在營前列成步兵方陣，貝恩哈德也以方陣接戰：他先以騎兵作假退，意圖引誘敵方出陣追擊，但九月濕滑的地形令騎兵難以展開，計策落空，於是改以步兵一波接一波衝擊雷達利人方陣，雙方自清晨打到日暮，傷亡慘重。薩克森騎兵全程由提特馬爾握在手中作為預備隊，警戒兩翼，以防倫岑守軍出城反突或另有敵軍出現；正因敵方沒有騎兵可以威脅薩克森方陣的側背，這支預備隊才得以留到最後。午後戰局終於改變：薩克森騎兵成功迂迴雷達利人方陣側翼，一鼓作氣衝入，擊潰其陣形；崩散者被騎兵在田野間追殺，或被逼入附近的湖泊溺斃。九月五日清晨，倫岑守軍見援兵盡滅，遂開城投降。整場戰鬥的勝負手是「側翼」與「持久」：方陣結得越緊，矛尖越密，突破越難，而一旦被迂迴，密陣反而成了無處可轉的災難。
tacticsEn: The action falls into four phases. On 30 August the Saxon army reached Lenzen and at once raised a fortified camp after the Roman fashion, with outposts and a screen of mounted scouts, while the garrison stayed inside its walls; the Saxons brought tents and provisions for a protracted blockade. On 3 September Bernhard's patrols found a large Redarii force that was planning a night attack on the camp, so the camp was put on a heightened alert through the night, and what came instead of the night attack was the battle of the following day. On 4 September the Redarii deployed into an infantry phalanx facing the Saxon camp, and Bernhard matched them with a phalanx of his own: he first attempted a feigned retreat with the cavalry, hoping to pull the enemy out of its lines in pursuit, but the wet ground of September left the riders no room to manoeuvre, the scheme failed, and he went over to infantry assault after infantry assault against the Redarii line, and the two sides fought from morning until dusk with heavy losses on both. Throughout the day the Saxon cavalry was held in reserve by Thietmar, covering both flanks against a sortie from the garrison of Lenzen or the appearance of another enemy force; precisely because the enemy had no cavalry that could threaten the flanks of the Saxon phalanx, that reserve could be kept back for the last hour. In the afternoon the battle finally turned: the Saxon cavalry worked round the flank of the Redarii formation and charged into it, breaking it apart; the fugitives were cut down in the fields by the riders or driven into a nearby lake and drowned. On the morning of 5 September the garrison of Lenzen, seeing that its relief had been destroyed, opened its gates. The whole engagement turned on flanking and on endurance: the tighter a phalanx stood, the denser its spearheads and the harder it was to break, and once it had been outflanked, that very density became a disaster with nowhere to turn.
data: 可核實的數字與時間如下。背景方面，亨利一世在九二九年五月集合的王家軍隊約一萬五千人，用於對波希米亞的兩面進攻；本役實際交戰的兵力，古籍只說薩克森軍以精選民兵為主力，另有各伯爵與諸侯軍事家戶的騎兵與步卒，具體數目無載；雷達利人一方的兵力同樣不明，只知足以列成正面方陣，並在整日纏鬥中令薩克森軍付出慘重傷亡。時間線是：九二九年七月底或八月初，雷達利人奪取德意志式的瓦爾斯萊本要塞並屠殺守軍；此前一年，亨利一世已攻下勃蘭登堡與加納；九二九年八月三十日薩克森軍抵達倫岑並開始圍城，九月三日偵察發現敵軍，九月四日會戰，九月五日守軍投降。傷亡方面，史料只說薩克森損失慘重、雷達利人全軍覆沒，並無可靠數字；唯一的具體記錄是梅爾澤堡的提特馬爾所述，家族有兩位名叫洛塔爾的曾祖父陣亡於此。地理與氣候亦見於記載：倫岑位於易北河南岸不遠的埃爾德河畔，會戰當日地面潮濕，騎兵假退因地濘而失效，敗軍被追入附近湖泊。往後的時序是：九三二年魯塞人歸附，九三四年烏克蘭人被征服，烏克蘭人仍不斷攻擊北方邊疆，至九五四年才由薩克森東方邊侯吉羅打敗。
dataEn: The figures and dates that can be checked run as follows. In the background, the royal host Henry I assembled in May 929 numbered about fifteen thousand men and was meant for the two-pronged campaign against Bohemia; the actual forces engaged at Lenzen are given not in numbers but in kind, for the Saxon army consisted above all of the select levy, together with the cavalry and infantry of the military households of the counts and nobles, while the strength of the Redarii is likewise unknown, only large enough to have formed a front-line phalanx and to have fought the Saxons through the whole day at heavy cost on both sides. The timeline is this: in late July or early August 929 the Redarii seized the German fortress of Walsleben by storm and killed its garrison; in the year before, Henry I had already stormed Brandenburg and taken Gana; on 30 August 929 the Saxon army reached Lenzen and began the blockade; on 3 September the scouts found the enemy force; on 4 September came the battle; and on 5 September the garrison surrendered. On losses the sources say only that the Saxons suffered heavily and that the Redarii were wiped out, and give no reliable numbers; the one specific record is that of Thietmar of Merseburg, who states that two great-grandfathers of his family, both named Lothar, fell here. Geography and weather are likewise attested: Lenzen stands on the Elde, not far from the Elbe, the ground on the day of the battle was wet, the feigned retreat of the cavalry failed because of the mud, and the defeated were driven into a nearby lake. The later sequence runs as follows: the Lusatians were brought to submission in 932, the Ukrani in 934, and the Ukrani went on raiding the northern march until Gero defeated them in 954.
cause: 起火點是九二九年七月底至八月初雷達利人的叛變。這支部族原是德意志人的附庸，按約向薩克森納貢，卻在那年夏天攻破瓦爾斯萊本這座德意志式堡壘，屠殺守軍，使沿易北河的邊防體系出現缺口。消息傳開後，易北河與奧得河之間的其他斯拉夫部族相繼起事，薩克森的徵貢路線與新建堡壘同時受到威脅，薩克森與維萊提聯盟之間維持數十年的附庸關係面臨破裂。國王亨利一世的處理方式，是沿用自己既有的戰略準則：不遠征報復，而是先奪取敵境內的堡壘，把防禦體系向前推。倫岑因此被選為目標——它位於易北河東岸，是斯拉夫人越河襲擊薩克森的主要基地，奪下它，薩克森就不必在自家腹地應戰。背景層面上，這一場戰爭同時是九二九年波希米亞戰事的一環：亨利一世自北面率軍進逼布拉格，阿爾努爾夫自南面入侵，馬扎爾人則利用波希米亞的縱容從側翼襲擾薩克森與圖林根。修築堡壘、用堡壘切斷易北河兩岸往來，是亨利率領的東境防禦體系的核心；而卡面上的斯巴達長矛所代表的長柄刺擊傳統，恰好是這個體系裡唯一能在堡壘外以方陣正面硬撼的技術。
causeEn: The spark was the rising of the Redarii in the late summer of 929. This people had been a tributary of the Germans and owed tribute to the Saxons, but in that summer they stormed the German-style fortress of Walsleben and killed its garrison, opening a gap in the new defensive line along the Elbe. The news spread, and the other Slavic peoples between the Elbe and the Oder rose in turn, so that the routes by which tribute was collected and the new fortresses were both threatened at once, and the tributary arrangement that had held between the Saxons and the Veleti confederation for decades was close to breaking apart. King Henry I answered in the way he had always used: instead of a long punitive expedition into the interior, he seized a fortress in enemy territory and pushed the defensive system forward. Lenzen was chosen for exactly that reason, for it stood on the eastern bank of the Elbe as the main base from which the Slavs struck across the river into Saxony, and taking it would spare the Saxons the need to fight on their own soil. At a deeper level this fight was one part of the Bohemian war of 929: Henry I advanced on Prague from the north with his army, Arnulf of Bavaria attacked from the south, and the Magyars, tolerated by the Bohemians, harried Saxony and Thuringia from the flank. Building fortresses to seal the crossings of the Elbe was the core of Henry's eastern defence, and the tradition of long thrusting embodied by the dory on the card was precisely the one technique able to hold a line in the open field before a fortress, in phalanx, against a charging enemy.
impact: 倫岑的勝利解決了亨利一世東線的一個結構性問題：易北河從此不再是可以被斯拉夫人隨意跨越的進攻通道。史料直接指出，此役之後到亨利一世去世為止，易北河沿岸再無有效的斯拉夫抵抗。與此同時，一條從薩勒河延伸到易北河的堡壘線在戰後成形，梅森等要塞相繼落成並駐防，易北河成為德意志王國東部的邊界，後來北方邊疆與勃蘭登堡邊侯領的框架，都沿著這條線鋪開。九二九年之後，亨利一世繼續把築堡與討伐合為一體：他在易北河與奧得河之間步步推進，再於九三二年迫魯塞人歸附、九三四年迫烏克蘭人臣服，而魯塞人與烏克蘭人此前的叛亂，正是倫岑一役之後逐步被平定的。對北方斯拉夫人而言，倫岑的意義不只是一場敗仗，更是教會傳播與王權推進的前哨：從此易北河東岸的堡壘網與傳教活動緊密並進，薩克森與奧博特里特的傳教區在往後二十年間深入腹地。從軍事技術史看，這場戰役也留下了一份教科書式的記錄——以方陣與騎兵迂迴戰勝缺乏騎兵的部族聯盟，此後數百年仍是德意志步兵戰術的骨架。
impactEn: The victory at Lenzen settled a structural problem on Henry I's eastern front: the Elbe was no longer a channel that the Slavs could cross at will. The sources state directly that after this battle there was no effective Slavic resistance along the Elbe for the rest of Henry's reign. At the same time the line of fortresses from the Saale to the Elbe took its final shape, with places such as Meissen built and garrisoned, and the Elbe became the eastern frontier of the German kingdom; the framework of the later northern march and of the Margraviate of Brandenburg grew out of that same line. After 929 Henry I went on combining fortification with campaign, pushing forward between the Elbe and the Oder and then forcing the Lusatians to submit in 932 and the Ukrani in 934, so that the rebellions of the Lusatians and the Ukrani were gradually put down in the years following Lenzen. For the northern Slavs the meaning of Lenzen went beyond a single defeat: from then on the network of fortresses and the work of Christian missions advanced together, and the Saxon and Obotrite mission areas pushed deep into the interior over the following two decades. In the history of military technique the battle also left a textbook record of a phalanx and a cavalry flank beating a tribal confederation that had no cavalry at all, a pattern that remained the backbone of German infantry warfare for centuries afterwards.
result: 結果是壓倒性的：九月四日雷達利人的野戰部隊在方陣崩潰後被薩克森騎兵在田野間大量殺傷，敗軍一部被逼入附近湖泊而溺斃，該部全軍覆沒，沒有成建制的殘部留下；九月五日清晨，倫岑守軍見援軍已盡，開城投降，堡寨落入薩克森之手。雷達利人的首領姓名不見於史冊，倫岑守軍也沒有留下抵抗到底的記錄——守軍交出了工事，這在編年史的敘述裡被寫成一次乾淨的收場。梅爾澤堡伯爵提特馬爾記下了家族失去兩位洛塔爾的代價，薩克森一方同樣付出慘重傷亡，這是一場以慘勝告終的會戰。戰後的走向早已注定：亨利一世在九二九年對波希米亞的戰役迫使瓦茨拉夫一世恢復歲貢，易北河防線固定下來，魯塞人與烏克蘭人分別在九三二年與九三四年被壓服，烏克蘭人的邊境騷擾延續到九五四年才被吉羅終結。九三六年亨利一世去世，帝國交給其子奧托一世，薩克森在東境的優勢從此不再依賴國王個人的戰術判斷，而成為可以世代維持的邊疆政策。
resultEn: The result was overwhelming. On 4 September the field army of the Redarii broke up after the charge and was cut down in large numbers by the Saxon riders, part of the fugitives being driven into a nearby lake and drowned; the whole force was wiped out and no organised remnant survived it. On the morning of 5 September the garrison of Lenzen, seeing that its relief had been destroyed, opened its gates, and the stronghold passed into Saxon hands. The name of the Redarii leader is nowhere in the record, and the garrison of Lenzen left no account of fighting to the last; it handed over the works instead, and the chroniclers wrote the episode up as a clean ending. Thietmar, Count of Merseburg, set down the price paid by his family in two men named Lothar, and the Saxons paid heavily in return: it was a hard-won victory. The direction of events after it was already fixed. Henry's Bohemian campaign of 929 forced Wenceslaus I to resume his yearly tribute, the Elbe line was settled, the Lusatians and the Ukrani were subdued in 932 and 934, and the last of the Ukrani raids was ended by Gero in 954. Henry I died in 936 and the kingdom passed to his son Otto I; from then on the Saxon advantage in the east no longer depended on the personal judgement of a king in the field but became a frontier policy that could be maintained from one generation to the next.
